articles.title: New York AG secures $1.37B court judgment against NovaTech founders
articles.snippet: The judgment follows an August 2025 default ruling against the founders over a Ponzi scheme that targeted Haitian and other immigrant communities.

articles.title: Japan weighs tighter oversight of DeFi, self-custodial wallets
articles.snippet: Japan’s financial regulator is exploring measures to curb illicit finance risks, including potential restrictions on access to DeFi services.

articles.title: $7 Billion in Bitcoin Options Just Expired: Here’s What It Means
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s largest options expiry this month comes as traders increasingly seek protection against further losses, with some hedging against a potential drop to $40,000 before the end of the year.
